[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Margaret is recorded on this profile as born in 1643 and as the daughter of [[Glasgow-2459|Thomas Glasgow]] and [[Thomsone-70|Agnes Thomsone]]. The attribution of the exact date 16 November 1643 to this household remains unproved; see the research note below.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1103]] is assessed at 70% (probable). Inherited Thomas Glasgow/Agnes Thomsone parentage is unproved for Margaret-3050; its borrowed 16 November 1643 date belongs to a William Glasgow/Bessie Howie entry. The Thomas/Agnes Inveresk family sequence remains a specific, chronologically feasible basis for retaining Margaret as their child, despite the borrowed exact date.

Probable inherited family placement, not proof from the Glasgow William/Bessie entry. The shared date does not establish a father replacement or a merge with Margaret-1524.

Next useful test: Find an independent Inveresk Margaret entry in the Thomas/Agnes household.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-3050 WikiTree profile export for Glasgow-3050]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


The Scotland’s People Old Parish Registers births and baptisms index lists MARGARET GLASGOW on 16 November 1643 in Glasgow, parish 644 / 1, reference 30 / 360, with parents “WM. GLASGOW/BESSIE HOWIE”.<ref>Scotland’s People, [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ Old Parish Registers, births and baptisms], exact surname Glasgow through 1700, index text supplied 10 September 2026: MARGARET GLASGOW, 16/11/1643, WM. GLASGOW/BESSIE HOWIE, female, Glasgow, parish 644 / 1, reference 30 / 360. Original register image not inspected for this review.</ref> This matches the named parents and date of [[Glasgow-1524|Margaret Glasgow]], rather than providing evidence for the Thomas Glasgow and Agnes Thomsone household recorded here. The index does not establish a separate Inveresk birth on that date. A shared date is insufficient evidence to merge these profiles or to change their parent relationships. An independent original entry is needed to establish this Margaret’s dates and parents. The date in a combined births and baptisms index is not automatically a birthday.

A possible identification concerns Margaret Glasgow. The banns/marriage index records Margrat Glasgow and John Aiton on 18 October 1693 at Cambusnethan.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 628/10 / 344; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.

A possible identification concerns Margaret Glasgow. The banns/marriage index records Margaret Glasgow and John Tailzer on 18 December 1690 at Walston.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 658/10 / 206; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.
